event.text: You can manage this at home for now — a small, itchy, non-spreading rash after gardening usually reflects skin contact with a plant or irritant. A pharmacist can advise on over-the-counter options. If you develop breathing difficulty, throat tightness, voice change, or rapidly progressing swelling of the tongue, throat or face, call 911 immediately. If instead you notice mild lip or facial swelling without any breathing or throat symptoms, or the rash spreads widely, blisters, weeps, or becomes painful, warm or feverish, seek clinical assessment the same day — urgent care or another same-day service if messaging review isn't available.
